Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics components: a large-scale AP-MS using SILAC to identify interactors of H/ACA proteins, and a targeted PTM analysis of GAR1 arginine methylation using chymotrypsin digestion and DDA. The base workflow is SILAC-DDA, and the modifier is AP-MS. PTM search parameters for arginine methylation are explicitly detailed.

scope: whole-cell extracts were immunoprecipitated (IP) with anti-GFP antibodies, and pellets were subjected to quantitative mass-spectrometry analysis

Each extract was then incubated with 50µl of GFP-Trap beads (Chromotek) for 1.5 h at 4°C, washed five times with HNT buffer, and beads from the different isotopic conditions were finally pooled. Bound proteins were eluted by adding 1% SDS to the beads and boiling for 10min.

The immunoprecipitated material was resuspended in Laemmli buffer and separated by SDS-PAGE. After colloidal blue staining of the gel, the band corresponding to GFP-GAR1 molecular weight was cut and digested with chymotrypsin (10 ng/ml, O/N). Digested peptides were analyzed by LC–MSMS
